info.name: NovaBank API
info.description:
Functional API coverage for NovaBank, organised as journeys rather than as endpoint-by-endpoint checks.

Each folder tells a story whose steps depend on one another: the account, the beneficiary, the opening balance and the resulting transfer reference are all carried forward from the request that produced them. That chaining is what this collection contributes that the REST Assured suite does not — that suite owns the authorization matrix, the response schemas and the regression sweep, which are awkward to express here.

Folders 00 and 05 are read-only and safe against any environment. Folders 02, 03 and 04 create data and move money, so point them at a local or CI database.

Run everything with Newman:

    npm run test

Sign-in is two steps everywhere: credentials raise an MFA challenge, and the challenge is exchanged for a session. With QA_MODE on, the one-time code comes back in the response, so no mail server is needed.
